Duplicator preserves truncated block indices in an indefinite k-pebble game; each occupied block has sufficient matching vertices after lifting the moving pebble. The formal-language generating functions count alternating signed block words with terminal size >=2; saturating one block gives every larger model order. Independent exhaustive creation-word spectra for n<=10 and k=2..4 matched both rational series. This is a correctness judgment, not originality.
